name: Beauty & Wellness
purpose: Business-aware design guidance for salons, spas, barbers, beauty studios, skincare clinics, wellness studios and appointment-led personal-care businesses.
productPrinciple: Services, practitioner trust, treatment suitability, availability and booking are the product. Aesthetic polish must not obscure practical booking information or inflate claims.
primaryJourneys: book or enquire through a verified channel
rejectConditions: design before research gate is ready
before-and-after media without provenance or consent
generated people presented as real clients
hidden booking terms or unclear prices when known
decorative luxury visuals unrelated to service or practitioner
booking UI presented as integrated when it is only a prototype
motion that interferes with service comparison or accessibility
